result.title: Streaming On-Policy Distillation: Decoupling Three Clocks for Stage-Wise Supervision Consumption
result.summary: In on-policy distillation (OPD), response completion, supervision delivery, and parameter updates need not share the same granularity. We develop streaming OPD by decoupling these three clocks: a response repeatedly delivers newly generated segments while generation continues, retaining the full causal prefix at each delivery and computing loss only on new positions. A consumption protocol then organizes supervision budgets, position selection, staleness handling, and update scheduling, allowing control over quantity, coverage, and version lag across training stages. In GSM8K experiments distilling Qwen3-4B into Qwen3-0.6B with VERL, supervised-budget matching reduces the early gap between best test accuracies over seven common candidates from 4.55 to 2.42 points. Synchronous continuation from the same checkpoint reaches 73.39% best test accuracy over seven common candidates at u=384,...,576, versus 74.30% synchronous and 71.95% budget-matched (differences -0.91 and -2.35 points); an unpaired extended record reaches 76.12%. Freshness filtering and disagreement-overlap selection improve local peaks but do not establish sustained advantages. A system prototype shows lower data-supply waiting times without establishing an equal-update speedup. Quality recovery and supply-side benefits are assessed separately; end-to-end gains must account for continuation cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出流式 on-policy 蒸馏，把响应生成、监督投递与参数更新这三种粒度解耦，用一套消费协议组织监督预算、位置选择、陈旧度处理与更新调度，并在 GSM8K 上分别评估质量恢复与数据供给等待时间。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按位置选择性投放监督、控制版本滞后与更新节奏」的协议，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的逐步贡献分配与监督粒度设计提供可核查线索，但纯文本蒸馏向多模态 latent 推理的迁移需自行判断，摘要中多数增益亦未确立稳定优势。
